text:
Remocn: Claude Code plugin & agent skill for making Remotion videos

Remocn is a Claude Code plugin, agent skill and MCP server for making Remotion videos from 933 MIT-licensed Remotion components. Your agent plans a storyboard, installs the components into your Remotion project with the shadcn CLI and writes the video: a product demo, a launch video, a changelog video or a social clip.

 Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and any agent that loads skills or connects to MCP. 

 

 Install

Pick one. The plugin already includes the skill and the MCP server.

 You use Install You get 
 --- --- --- 
 Claude Code /plugin install remocn --marketplace Remocn/remocn The /remocn:video workflow, helper agents, the skill and the MCP tools 
 Codex codex plugin marketplace add Remocn/remocn then codex plugin add remocn@remocn The same plugin 
 Cursor, Copilot or any agent that loads skills npx skills add Remocn/remocn The agent skill 
 Any MCP client The MCP server: search, docs, video plans, previews 
 Your own hands npx shadcn@latest add @remocn/blur-reveal One component's source in your repo 

Remotion is a prerequisite. The plugin creates a project in an empty folder; by hand it's npx create-video@latest .

 Make a Remotion video with Claude Code

 

 /remocn:video runs brief → storyboard → install → compose → visual check → hand-off. It stops after the storyboard so you can change direction before any code is written. Then the scene-reviewer agent renders stills of every beat and checks them for clipped text, empty frames and low contrast. The video lands in src/videos/ /index.tsx ; render it with npx remotion render or open it in Remocn Studio.

Also in the plugin: /remocn:changelog turns git tags, commits or merged PRs into a changelog video, /remocn:add installs and places one component, /remocn:setup prepares a Remotion project for shadcn add . Plugin docs.

 Craft rules: what we ban

Agent-made Remotion videos look generic for the same few reasons. The Remocn skill and the plugin's scene-reviewer hold your agent's own additions to these rules (why AI videos look generic, Craft):

- No glow halos or blurred color blobs behind headings
- No gradient-filled text. Mark the one word that matters with weight, the accent or a highlight
- No decorative ALL-CAPS or wide letter-spacing. Sentence case, default tracking
- No more than one accent color 
- No panels that all pop in on the same frame. Stagger entrances, one focal action per beat
- No clipped animations. Every component states its length in frames; a Sequence is never shorter
- No invented generic dashboards. Show a believable product surface or your real screenshots
- No lorem or "Scene A" placeholder copy 
- No Math.random() . Randomness is seeded, so every render is the same
- No invented props or durations. The agent reads the component's page before it uses it

Components whose effect is the point ( tracking-in , shader gradients) are exempt; the rules apply to what the agent writes by hand.

 Remotion's official skills vs Remocn

They answer different questions and work together.

 Remotion's official skills and plugin Remocn plugin and skill 
 --- --- --- 
 Answers How to write correct Remotion code What goes on screen: which component for each beat, for how many frames 
 Install npx skills add remotion-dev/skills /plugin install remocn --marketplace Remocn/remocn or npx skills add Remocn/remocn 
 Output Code the agent writes from scratch Code built from installed component source files, in your repo 
 Ready-made scenes No 933 components and full video templates 
 Cost Free; Remotion may need a company license Free, MIT; Remotion's license still applies 

We ran both setups on the same 15-second brief on November 10, 2026, with timings, costs and both MP4s: the test.

 Remotion MCP server (hosted)

Remocn runs a hosted MCP server for making videos with Remotion at Add the URL to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client. There's no API key and no account.

 
 --- --- 
 URL 
 Transport Streamable HTTP 
 Auth None 
 Access Read-only; it does not render video 
 License MIT, free 
 Clients Claude Code, Claude Desktop and claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, any Streamable HTTP client 

Tools:

- search components : find Remocn components by query, vibe or length in frames
- get component : one component's docs as Markdown: props, usage example, install command
- plan video : turn a brief into a beat-by-beat storyboard with component picks
- preview component : a live preview link, played inline in clients that support MCP Apps

Your agent installs what it picks with npx shadcn@latest add @remocn/ , and you render with Remotion as usual. Setup for every client: MCP server docs. Comparing options? See Remotion MCP servers compared.

 Remocn Studio

Rather direct the video than write it? Remocn Studio is a free, open-source macOS app where your own coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Grok) builds the video from Remocn components while you watch the live preview and export.

 Why Remocn

- Production-ready Remotion
